intro: Marina del Rey wraps around North America's largest man-made small-craft harbor, with waterfront restaurants, a calm swimming beach and a bike path that runs to Venice and Playa del Rey. The best food is often a block off the water, along Washington Boulevard and in the strip malls inland.

fsq: Foursquare: Marina del Rey, Culver City, Playa Vista, Venice
gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)
